            self.n = len(s)
            self.i = 0

                self.i += 1
        def parse_expression(self):
            value = self.parse_term()
            while True:
                self.skip()
                if self.i < self.n and self.s[self.i] in '+-':
                    op = self.s[self.i]
                    self.i += 1
                    right = self.parse_term()
                    value = value + right if op == '+' else value - right

            return value

                    self.i += 1
                    right = self.parse_factor()
